# NameSilo Portfolio Company Marlow Launches AI Software Creation Platform
## FAQ
### What did NameSilo Technologies (URLOF) announce about Marlow AI on August 11, 2026?
NameSilo Technologies announced the beta launch of portfolio company Marlow AI’s software creation platform and confirmed it holds about 36% ownership. According to NameSilo, the platform uses AI to help users build, deploy and manage software while keeping full ownership and infrastructure control.
